note: Hebrew tse tse means 'go out, be gone'; Shimei is driving David away, not summoning him, which 'come out' can suggest to a modern reader.
beliyya'al is a common noun meaning 'worthlessness, baseness'; the KJV's transliteration reads like a proper name or demon.
The qere ko yeqallel ki gives 'so let him curse, for'; the ketiv ki yeqallel vekhi gives 'if he curses and if/because'. KJV follows the qere, mine the ketiv; the sense is close.
Hebrew yechi hammelek is simply 'may the king live'; God is not named.
